description: Live dictation on a phone: partial text while speaking, final text at each pause. Same audio, same scoring, every model.

extra_sets.code_switch: 40 own recordings mixing PT/EN/ES mid-sentence (consented, kept out of git)
extra_sets.noise: FLEURS clips mixed with cafe/street noise at 10 dB SNR

normalization: whisper_basic_text_normalizer + lowercase + strip punctuation for WER; punctuation scored separately

metrics.wer: final text vs reference, per language (lower is better)
metrics.first_partial_ms: audio start -> first partial token on screen
metrics.partial_stability: share of partial words that survive into the final text (higher is better)
metrics.rtf: processing time / audio time (lower is better; must stay < 1 sustained)
metrics.energy_mwh_per_min: battery drain per minute of audio (BatteryManager / perfetto)
metrics.thermal_throttle_after_s: seconds of continuous dictation before sustained slowdown

ranking: Pareto: WER(mean of pt-BR, en-US, es-419) vs final_latency_ms, under the constraint rtf < 0.5 and no thermal throttle in 10 min
